override_reasons.free_transfers: 2026-11-11: root cause found and fixed -- fpl.league._free_transfers_for_manager was counting a manager's opening gameweek as a normal banked week, inflating the computed value to 2 when the FPL app correctly shows 1 (FPL's rule: no free transfer is earned or spent building your initial squad). Override no longer needed now that the computed value matches the app; left as null/documented here for the next time a real discrepancy shows up.
